entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in 2022, offering spot trading, conversion, custody-related account services, launchpad, rewards, and streaming-oriented ecosystem features.
entity.notes: Current first-party trading and homepage surfaces expose live spot markets and account registration. CoinGecko identifies Lithuania and a 2022 establishment year. Public first-party legal-entity disclosure is limited, so confidence remains medium and January 1 is used only as a year-level launch marker.
